responsibility: Provides the MSP430 target’s C-family front-end hook for target pragmas/address spaces. Its main responsibility is to register the MSP430-specific named address spaces exposed to C code, notably __near and, when compiling for the extended MSP430X ISA, __far, so that the C front end can parse and type-check source-level address-space qualifiers using the backend’s ADDR_SPACE_NEAR and ADDR_SPACE_FAR identifiers.
